title: Naturality of the cohomology boundary under pullback
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and let $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal E\to\mathcal C\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. For a morphism $u:\mathcal C'\to\mathcal C$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, let $u^*\mathcal E$ denote the pullback short exact sequence. Under the canonical identification $\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal A)=H^1(X,\mathcal A)$ from [lem-sc-ext-locally-free], the connecting maps are natural: for every $t:\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal C'$, $\partial_{\mathcal E}(u\circ t)=\partial_{u^*\mathcal E}(t)$.

source.place: Cohomology Lemma Tag 0B3A, functoriality of the boundary under pullback

proof.text: Write $p:\mathcal E\to\mathcal C$ and construct $\mathcal E'=u^*\mathcal E$ as pairs $(e,c')$ with $p(e)=u(c')$. The first projection $v:\mathcal E'\to\mathcal E$ and $u$ give a morphism of short exact sequences $(\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal A},v,u)$: the left square commutes because the inclusion of $\mathcal A$ in $\mathcal E'$ is $a\mapsto(a,0)$, and the right square is $p v=u p'$ by the defining equation. The kernel of $p'$ is $\mathcal A$, and $p'$ is locally surjective since $p$ is, so the upper row is short exact.

source.place: Section Tag 01DZ, short exact sequences of module sheaves; elementary pullback construction

proof.text: By [def-sc-sheaf-cohomology-functor], $H^i(X,-)$ is the right derived functor of the additive left exact global-sections functor on the module category with enough injectives. Apply the naturality clause of [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-universal-delta-functor] to the morphism $(\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal A},v,u)$ from Step 1 in degree zero. Its equation is $H^1(\operatorname{id}_{\mathcal A})\circ\partial_{u^*\mathcal E}=\partial_{\mathcal E}\circ H^0(u)$. The left factor is the identity; identifying $H^0(X,\mathcal C')$ with $\operatorname{Hom}_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal C')$, $H^0(u)(t)=u\circ t$. Evaluate the equation at $t$; both sides lie in the same $H^1(X,\mathcal A)$, so the identification with $\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal A)$ introduces no further comparison.
